B. Code artifacts (from the Tx3 definitions) to test the execution of the transactions mapped from user intents for each protocol.

B1. The code artifacts for each protocol successfully executes the transactions mapped from its user intents.
C1. Documentation and diagrams for each protocol are publicly available and explain how to work with its Tx3 definition.
